source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At the May 2024 UIFontSize revision, changing the font size in safe mode updated an in-memory value and registered windows, without writing mail.uifontsize. Keep temporary safe-mode state separate from a persistent preference. Bug 1893107 arose from a race in this area.
title: Keep safe-mode font changes out of saved preferences
